resource: Loot-table entries planned for one creature death
allocation_impact: Checked before allocating any plan storage; a source loot table over the ceiling is rejected whole, never truncated to fit.
boundary_tests: max=16: a 16-entry loot table is planned
max+1=17: a 17-entry loot table is rejected before planning
consumers: apps/game-server/src/combat/loot_plan.rs (plan_creature_loot: rejects a loot table with more than 16 entries before planning)
notes: D77, decision §4.1: "16 pozycji". Registered by OTV2-20260928-combat-d2a-loot-plan.
